title: Marketing blurb: TWSE surge-stocks dashboard (one paragraph, EN)
description: Write ONE paragraph (roughly 60-100 words) of English marketing copy promoting a free Taiwan stock-market tool. Product facts (use these, do not invent features): Name: TWSE Surge-Stocks DNA (大飆股DNA). It is a free, open backtest dashboard for Taiwan-listed (TWSE) surge stocks, published on GitHub Pages at https://slashmantools.us/twse-surge-stocks-dna/dashboard.html . Under the hood: a Python quantitative screening engine implementing a 9-step multi-timeframe strategy using technical indicators (MACD, DMI, RSI, VR), backed by TWSE historical data and covered by ~95 unit tests; the dashboard visualizes backtest results with Chart.js. Audience: retail traders and quant-curious investors interested in Taiwan stocks. Tone: confident, concrete, no hype-words like revolutionary/game-changing; mention it is free and runs in the browser; include the URL once. Include a required compliance note at the end of the paragraph (one short clause is fine): for research/education only, not investment advice. Deliverable: output the single paragraph as plain text, nothing else.
result: TWSE Surge-Stocks DNA (大飆股DNA) is a free, open backtest dashboard you can open directly in your browser at https://slashmantools.us/twse-surge-stocks-dna/dashboard.html . Built on a Python quantitative engine with nearly a hundred unit tests, it runs a 9-step multi-timeframe screen — combining MACD, DMI, RSI, and VR — against TWSE historical surge-stock data, then visualizes every result interactively with Chart.js. If you trade Taiwan-listed stocks or want to understand how a rules-based approach would have performed, this gives you a concrete starting point, no installation required. For research and education purposes only; not investment advice.
